description: This file defines an abstract class AbstractRecipient within the OrangeHRM project's mailing system. It establishes a contract for email recipient objects by specifying methods to retrieve email addresses and names, but contains no implementations.

classes.name: AbstractRecipient
classes.description: An abstract class that defines the interface for email recipient objects, requiring implementation of methods to get email address and name.

methods.name: getEmailAddress
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the email address of the recipient.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the full name of the recipient.
